jobs.title: Communications Manager

The "Manager" title and "proven experience" framing point to a mid-level comms professional, and the candidate lacks the specific communications-campaign track record the role centres on.

The "Senior Consultant" title and expectations to lead global projects and advise on commercial transactions require professional consulting experience the candidate lacks, and the role assumes ESG/transactions domain knowledge not evidenced in the CV.

jobs.title: Curator: Modern Archives and Manuscripts
jobs.reason: This is a specialist curatorial role focused on 17th–18th century manuscripts and archives, which sits well outside the candidate's IR/policy/intelligence target zones. Additionally, the role cannot sponsor a Skilled Worker visa, which is likely a practical barrier.
